content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

Lower the load for now and only train pain-free. If the pain is sharp, shooting, or lasts more than a few days, stop deadlifting and see a doctor or physio.

💡 Until it settles, drop the weight by 30-50% or switch to a gentler hinge like Romanian deadlifts or hip thrusts. Keep your back neutral and the bar close to your body.

⚠️ Numbness, tingling, or pain running down a leg means stop and get checked right away.
